summary.text: Jeff Livingston is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Pricella Tiegen and Libertarian Doug Jones in a race with no incumbent.
He is a U.S. Army veteran who works as an IT specialist.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Livingston was born in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, and served in the U.S. Army from 2013 to 2017.
His career experience includes working as an IT specialist.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a father, husband and veteran who has lived in the district for 11 years.
Livingston ran for House District 15 in 2024, advancing from the Democratic primary on June 25, 2024, and lost the general election to incumbent Scott Bottoms.
He advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary for the seat.

In the 2026 survey, he named making housing more affordable, raising wages through worker protections and union access, and changing business tax incentives to favor small businesses among his priorities, and said he is personally passionate about education and the renewable energy transition.
